title: RationaleTagVocabulary
description:
The CLOSED vocabulary of per-position and per-candidate rationale tags used by the Pareto decision-support layer (BRIEF-2.2-c: 'per-position rationale tags').

Why closed: an open-ended free-text explanation cannot be tested, cannot be translated, and cannot be aggregated across candidates. Every tag here has (a) a machine-checkable trigger condition stated in terms of LandscapeResponse fields, and (b) a user-facing template. Adding a tag is a minor schema version bump; changing a trigger is a major one, because a downstream user may have filtered on it.

This document is data, not a schema. It is validated against `rationale_tags_meta.schema.json`.

tags.trigger: mean predicted dwell over codons [0,30) is in the upper tercile of the host's native highly-expressed distribution
tags.template: Codons {span} were kept translationally slow to preserve the 5' initiation ramp.

tags.trigger: the input had a 5' slow ramp and the candidate does not
tags.template: The natural slow ramp at codons {span} was removed; this raises predicted initiation rate but is associated with aggregation risk.

tags.trigger: mean unpaired probability over the initiation window increased by >= 0.10 versus input
tags.template: Secondary structure over the ribosome binding region was reduced, increasing predicted initiation.

tags.trigger: local accessibility worsened by >= 0.10 while another objective improved by >= 1 reference-range unit
tags.template: Local structure at {span} was allowed to worsen in exchange for a gain in {other_term}.

tags.trigger: a predicted pause site within 10 codons of an annotated or predicted domain boundary was retained
tags.template: A translational pause near the {domain} boundary was preserved to support co-translational folding.

tags.trigger: codon relative adaptiveness < 0.2 and the epistasis or kinetics delta of replacing it is unfavourable
tags.template: The rare codon at position {pos} was retained deliberately; replacing it degrades {term}.

tags.trigger: input codon w_i < 0.2, candidate codon w_i >= 0.5
tags.template: A rare codon at position {pos} was replaced with a more abundant synonym.

tags.trigger: predicted growth cost reduced by >= 0.02 relative growth-rate units versus input
tags.template: Predicted host burden fell by {delta:.1%} relative growth rate, mainly by shifting demand off the {anticodon} pool.

tags.trigger: joint search moved >= 15% of an isoacceptor's demand from one cistron to another
tags.template: Demand on {anticodon} was shifted from {cistron_a} to {cistron_b} to relieve contention.

tags.trigger: sum of pairwise coupling terms over the span improved by >= 1 SD of the host's native distribution
tags.template: Codon pairs across {span} were chosen for favourable context effects, not just individual codon frequency.

tags.trigger: a k-mer repeat violation present in the input is absent in the candidate
tags.template: A {k}-mer repeat at {span} was broken to meet synthesis constraints.

tags.trigger: a forbidden enzyme site present in the input is absent in the candidate
tags.template: The {enzyme} site at position {pos} was removed for {assembly_standard} assembly.

tags.trigger: the repair operator changed this span after variation, and the change degraded the objective vector
tags.template: Positions {span} were changed by constraint repair rather than by optimization; the objective cost was {delta}.

tags.trigger: per-position calibrated confidence < 0.5 over >= 5 consecutive codons
tags.template: Predictions over {span} are low-confidence; consider including this variant in a wet-lab test set.

tags.trigger: any term resolved with provenance.fallback = true
tags.template: No host-specific model exists for {host}; {n_terms} objective(s) used a fallback model and their uncertainty was widened.

tags.trigger: candidate lies outside the convex hull of the training distribution on the model's feature summary (Mahalanobis distance > 3)
tags.template: This candidate is unlike the sequences the model was trained on; treat its scores as extrapolation.

tags.trigger: candidate's ancestry includes an imported seed
tags.template: Derived from a {tool} seed after {n_generations} generations.

tags.trigger: fewer than 5% of editable codons differ from the input
tags.template: Only {n} codons differ from your input sequence.

tags.trigger: usage.cai is reported for this candidate; the span is the whole CDS
tags.template: CAI {value} is the geometric mean of relative adaptiveness on the loaded {subset} table. 1.0 means every counted codon is a top synonym of that table.

tags.trigger: a second reference table was scored on the same CDS and was not the table the search optimized
tags.template: On {reference} the same CDS scores {value}. That table did not choose the codons.

tags.trigger: a counted codon has relative adaptiveness 0 on the loaded table
tags.template: Codon {codon} at position {pos} has weight 0, so CAI is 0. Flooring that weight at the smallest positive weight scores {sensitivity}.

tags.trigger: the codon is not the most frequent synonym of the loaded table
tags.template: Position {pos} is {codon} rather than {baseline} because {reason}.
